neighbours.label: the legal force or standing of a ruling or body: 'binding' decisions, 'precedent', 'interlocutory', consultative 'status'; the same words in everyday senses stay quiet
fire: The panel's award is final and binding on the two companies.
The judge's ruling became a precedent for similar disputes.
The charity holds observer status at the World Health Organization.
An interlocutory appeal delayed the trial by a year.
Her opinion has no binding force on the lower courts.
Lawyers cited a precedent from the highest court of the state.
The tribunal has compulsory jurisdiction over maritime claims.
The association was granted consultative status by the Council of Europe.
quiet: The notebook has a leather binding and thick cream pages.
The skier adjusted the binding on her left boot.
His status among the local fishermen rose after the rescue.
Her gold status gets her free bags on most flights.
The new coach set a fast pace for the younger runners.
The band's final show drew two thousand fans to the park.
The chef cited a recipe from his grandmother's kitchen.
The bird has a long beak and a bright red crest.
